quotes.text: We all wear masks, pretending to be something we're not. 'Death of a Clown' was kind of a trigger point saying, 'What the hell am I doing? Am I just a clown, dancing and making people laugh? Is that all I am?' Of course, I realized I'm not. But questions were coming at me thick and fast.
I didn't know what to do with the songs. Ray was going in one direction and my creativity was turning inwards.
